subject: NextSteps: Purchase order & security package for Voxiom integration
messages:
From: Asha Raman <asha.raman@voxiom.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: Michael Li <michael.li@voxiom.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Voxiom — PO and security docs for Redwood integration

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at Voxiom has asked us to collect Redwood's standard onboarding packet so we can get a PO in place and confirm the security posture before go-live. Can you please share the following items:

- Executed DPA (or DocuSign link)
- SOC 2 Type II report or a link where we can review the auditor attestation
- Current subprocessor inventory (CSV is fine)
- Invoicing instructions and preferred PO format (we use Coupa)

We are ready to move forward and would like to have the PO issued this week if possible. I can share our vendor form if you need any additional fields (tax id, remit address, payment terms).

Attaching our vendor intake template for your reference (voxiom_vendor_intake.xlsx) — we will fill the internal fields once we have the DPA and SOC2 link.

Best,
Asha Raman
Head of Procurement
Voxiom
attachments: voxiom_vendor_intake.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
To: Asha Raman <asha.raman@voxiom.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Voxiom — PO and security docs for Redwood integration

Hi Asha — thanks, and great to hear you're ready to move. Adding Ben (sales ops) and Jordan (finance ops) to close the PO path. Next steps from our side: 

1) DPA: Attached is the signed DPA (Voxiom_DPA_signed.pdf). If your legal team prefers DocuSign, we can also re-issue via e-sign; let us know.

2) SOC 2: We host our SOC 2 Type II evidence in a secure link. I attached a small text stub (SOC2_TypeII_Link.txt) with the access URL and brief instructions for secure read-only access. If you need offline copies for procurement, we can coordinate with security to produce redacted extracts.

3) Subprocessors: Attached CSV (subprocessor_inventory.csv) with current list and data categories processed. The file includes subprocessors for hosting, observability, and payments. Note: we update this monthly and will notify you of material changes.

4) PO / Invoicing: Our AP team prefers invoices to be routed to invoices@redwood.ai with the Redwood PO number in the subject and line items net 30. If Voxiom issues via Coupa, please send the Coupa PO number to invoices@redwood.ai and CC jordan_blake@redwood.ai so we can match. Preferred remit: Redwood Inference, 1201 Harbor Blvd, Suite 400, San Mateo, CA 94401 (EIN on request).

Action items for Voxiom: can you confirm the Coupa vendor ID and your required vendor fields (tax id, legal entity name, remit address)? Once we have that, Ben will create the internal PO and send you the Redwood PO number for the invoice.

Attachments: Voxiom_DPA_signed.pdf (PDF, 98KB); SOC2_TypeII_Link.txt (text, 1KB); subprocessor_inventory.csv (CSV, 14KB)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps unblock procurement.

Sofia Ivanova
Head of Supplier Success, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Asha Raman <asha.raman@voxiom.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@voxiom.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Voxiom — PO and security docs for Redwood integration

Thanks Sofia — received the attachments and confirming a few items: 

- We can accept the signed DPA via PDF; DocuSign is fine but not required.
- I forwarded the SOC2 link to our security reviewers and they requested a short access window (48 hours) for the reviewer team. Can you confirm the SOC2 link will allow read-only access during that window?
- Our procurement system (Coupa) requires a vendor tax id and a primary billing contact. I am attaching our completed vendor intake with the fields we need filled.
- For the subprocessor CSV, our privacy team will screen for any EU-based subprocessors; if there are items flagged we will follow up.

Coupa notes: When Voxiom submits the PO, the Coupa PO number will look like CP-2027-11####. Please include that number in the Redwood invoice subject.

Attached: voxiom_vendor_intake_filled.xlsx (filled vendor fields), subprocessor_inventory.csv (we converted to our columns)

I will ask procurement to open the PO once we confirm the vendor information and the SOC2 access window.

Best,
Asha
attachments: voxiom_vendor_intake_filled.xlsx (spreadsheet, 33KB)

Sofia — thanks for looping us in. I created an internal ticket and provisional PO so we can match as soon as Coupa issues. Details below: 

- Internal PO: RDW-PO-2027-0598 (provisional until we receive Coupa CP-2027-11####)
- AP contact for invoices: invoices@redwood.ai (please include RDW-PO-2027-0598 in the invoice subject if you submit before Coupa PO arrives)
- Jordan will confirm the final remit address and EIN today and reply-all.

Jordan — can you confirm Redwood's vendor profile fields (legal name, remit addr, EIN) so I can publish the vendor mapping to this ticket? Also confirm whether procurement needs the signed DPA attached to the PO notes or stored in the compliance folder.
